//mutate: Only runtime source. Build scripts and vite configs have no tests, so mutating them only adds survivors.
//timeoutMS: Every mutant reruns the whole suite, and two suites share the CPU; a tight timeout reports slow runs as detected mutants.
//disableTypeChecks: Mutant switches widen inferred types. This covers the TypeScript compiler; Angular's template checker is relaxed for tests in apps/client/projects/desktop/tsconfig.spec.json. Stryker's default only covers a top-level {test,src,lib}/**, which nothing in this layout matches, so this glob has to cover `mutate` above.
//ignorePatterns: These decide what Stryker copies into its sandbox. `target/**` is the Rust build directory; without it every run duplicates gigabytes.
